category.name: Architecture, CAD and BIM
category.description: Building information models, CAD geometry, construction management and GIS platforms with programmatic access.

entries.name: Autodesk Platform Services (APS)
entries.free_tier: Free tier: limited usage of rated APIs (Automation, Model Derivative, Flow Graph Engine, Reality Capture) per month, renews monthly; Pay as You Go beyond that needs a card or PayPal
entries.desc_en: Upload, translate, view and automate CAD/BIM files (Model Derivative, Data Management, Design Automation) via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Successor to Autodesk Forge; requires an Autodesk account and app registration in the APS console. Autodesk publishes reference MCP servers (Node.js, Python, .NET) to run yourself; no hosted endpoint.

free_plan.quota: limited monthly usage of rated APIs (Automation, Model Derivative, Flow Graph Engine, Reality Capture)

call.operation: translate a model to SVF2 (Model Derivative job)
call.async: poll GET https://developer.api.autodesk.com/modelderivative/v2/designdata/{urn}/manifest until status is success/failed/timeout

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Bentley iTwin Platform APIs
entries.free_tier: Free tier: Community plan with 100 credits/month, 10 GB cloud data, 100 GB reality data; non-commercial, non-production use only; no expiry
entries.desc_en: Create, manage and query digital twins, iModels and reality/reporting data for infrastructure projects via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Built on iTwin.js; free developer account, but production data volumes/usage are billed.

free_plan.quota: Community tier: 100 credits/month, 10 GB cloud data, 100 GB reality data; non-commercial, non-production

rate_limits.summary: Community: 500 requests/min and 5,000 calls/hour; Standard/Premium: 5,000 requests/min

call.operation: list the iModels of an iTwin

unit_price.summary: Usage billed in credits at $1.20 per credit (paid tiers); e.g. iModels 1 credit per 2 GB ingress/egress, Reporting 1 credit per 250,000 rows, Forms/Issues 1 credit per 50 queries

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Onshape REST API
entries.auth_hint: API key pair (access/secret) via Basic auth (base64 access:secret) or optional HMAC request signature; OAuth2 Bearer token for published apps
entries.free_tier: free tier (public documents only); private documents need a paid plan
entries.desc_en: Create, read and modify Onshape CAD documents, parts, assemblies and drawings programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Free-tier API access is limited to public documents; private/commercial use needs a paid Onshape subscription. FeatureScript MCP server is in early access via Onshape Labs (App Store subscription).

free_plan.quota: 2,500 API calls per user (Free plan; public documents only, non-commercial)

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(<ACCESS_KEY>:<SECRET_KEY>) or HMAC: Authorization: On <AccessKey>:HmacSHA256:<Signature>

rate_limits.summary: Annual call caps: Free/Standard 2,500 per user, Professional 5,000 per user, Enterprise 10,000 per full user; 429 on burst; public App Store OAuth apps exempt

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Procore API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> (OAuth2 authorization code / client credentials)
entries.free_tier: free developer sandbox; production requires customer's paid Procore plan
entries.desc_en: Read and write construction project data - RFIs, submittals, drawings, budgets, schedules - via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires joining the Procore Developer Program and OAuth app approval for production scopes; sandbox is free. Official AI Edge MCP (US02: us02.procore.com) authenticates with a Datagrid API key.

free_plan.quota: Developer Sandbox auto-created per registered app (seed data, separate OAuth credentials)

rate_limits.summary: Hourly limit (60-min window) plus spike limit (10-s window); see X-Rate-Limit-* headers; failed calls count

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Rhino.Compute (McNeel)
entries.auth_hint: optional RhinoComputeKey header; endpoint is otherwise open once deployed
entries.free_tier: Paid only: self-hosted, requires a Rhino license; core-hour billing at $0.10 per core per hour of Rhino uptime on Windows Server, no free allowance
entries.desc_en: Run Rhino/Grasshopper geometry operations headlessly via a stateless REST API you deploy yourself.
entries.notes: Not a hosted SaaS signup - must self-host on Windows/Linux (IIS, Azure, AWS); requires a Rhino license.

call.operation: run a Rhino geometry operation (curve length)

entries.name: Speckle API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token>, or OAuth2 for published apps
entries.free_tier: free Explore plan (1 project, 3 users), unlimited API calls
entries.desc_en: Send, receive and query 3D/BIM model data across CAD tools (Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, Tekla) via GraphQL API and SDKs.
entries.notes: Open-source data platform; free tier has unlimited API calls but limits project/user counts.

free_plan.quota: Explore plan: 1 project, up to 3 users, 100 versions, unlimited API calls

call.operation: list projects in a workspace via GraphQL
call.example: curl -X POST https://app.speckle.systems/graphql -H "Authorization: Bearer $SPECKLE_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"query($workspaceId: String!){ workspace(id: $workspaceId){ projects { totalCount items { id name createdAt } } } }","variables":{"workspaceId":"{workspace_id}"}}'

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Trimble Connect API
entries.desc_en: Manage Trimble Connect projects, files, BIM models, issues/topics and metadata via REST APIs (Core, Model, Organizer).
entries.notes: Requires a Trimble Identity developer account and a registered application.

rate_limits.summary: Not published; HTTP 429 Too Many Requests should be retried. Regional base URLs must be discovered via the /regions endpoint

entries.name: Zoo Text-to-CAD API (KittyCAD)
entries.free_tier: start free trial credits, then usage-based pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Convert CAD files and run modeling operations via REST API; text-to-CAD generation runs through the WebSocket copilot and the MCP server.
entries.notes: The current OpenAPI spec at api.zoo.dev has no REST endpoint that creates a text-to-CAD model (only list/get of past results); generation runs over WebSocket copilot endpoints or the MCP server.

free_plan.quota: Start free, then pay-as-you-go; some plans include monthly API usage

call.async: Files over 25 MB are converted asynchronously: take the returned id and poll GET https://api.zoo.dev/async/operations/{id}; smaller files return the result base64-encoded in outputs
call.operation: convert a CAD file to another format

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint
